T-001.Title: Align PLAN rule 19 with rule 20, add discriminating phase guards, and refresh the measured footprint

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Passage A (full CI at PLAN) is replaced in `skills/ngrace/ngrace-plan/SKILL.md` and `plugins/ngrace/skills/ngrace/ngrace-plan/SKILL.md`. The exact removed bytes are "Also drive the spec's `CloseEvidence` commands and the full CI in a faithful post-close copy at plan time, not only against the pre-close tree;". The exact replacement bytes are "Also drive the spec's narrow `CloseEvidence` commands on a faithful post-close copy at plan time, not only against the pre-close tree; the full CI-equivalent verification is EXECUTE close-time evidence and is not run at PLAN; independent full CI-equivalent verification on a faithfully applied and archived copy is also EXECUTE acceptance work, using direct CI commands separately from the active selected outer final gate;". Rule 20 and every other rule-19 obligation are left unchanged, and no other planner rule is reworded.

Passage B (obsolete archived-scratch causality) is replaced in both trees. The exact removed bytes are "The faithful post-close copy carries `.ngrace/scratch` read-only, because without it `review.confidently-wrong` fires on archived plans whose `BaselineAssertions` `MustExist` the buffer path and a planner reads defects the production tree does not show.". The exact replacement bytes are "A faithful post-close copy carries the actual declared inputs and dependencies the selected evidence reads, the applicable VCS state, and the necessary ignored/untracked inputs; a copy missing a declared input measures a state the selected commands cannot evaluate.". No archive reader, schema dispatch, or repository-specific record pipeline is introduced.

In `scripts/check-teaching-surface.ts` and the mirrored `TAUGHT_RULES` table in `scripts/check-teaching-surface.test.ts`, the stale-cause needle `{ skill: "ngrace-plan", section: "must_do", token: "review.confidently-wrong" }` becomes `{ skill: "ngrace-plan", section: "must_do", token: "necessary ignored/untracked inputs" }`, and a positive phase needle `{ skill: "ngrace-plan", section: "must_do", token: "is not run at PLAN" }` is added. Both positive tokens are required at the `ngrace-plan` `must_do` home, never merely elsewhere in the file; both are absent from the pre-repair `ngrace-plan` `SKILL.md`, so each removal is discriminating. The test's red-direction needle lists gain both new needles.

`scripts/check-teaching-surface.ts` gains a PRIVATE `checkStalePlanPhaseClaims(root)` — not exported, no new helper file, no new runtime export, no spec amendment. Its private inventory recursively collects every `SKILL.md` under both `skills/ngrace` and `plugins/ngrace/skills/ngrace`, including nested files; it must not reuse or claim the existing shallow `skillFilesUnder` enumerator, whose behavior for its other callers stays unchanged. It whitespace-normalizes both the file body and each forbidden fragment (collapsing runs of whitespace to one space) before literal matching, so a wrapped exact fragment cannot evade it; it claims no natural-language paraphrase detection. It returns non-zero through the existing `refuseDiagnostic` convention, naming the root-relative file and the matched fragment, when either stale passage is present: "and the full CI in a faithful post-close copy at plan time" or "because without it `review.confidently-wrong` fires on archived plans". It is wired into the existing `runTeachingSurfaceCheck(root)` entrypoint ahead of the shipped checks, and its integration is tested by calling `runTeachingSurfaceCheck`, not by exporting it. It is a new guard, not the existing `checkStaleReviewClaims` (which still guards its separate `decisions.md` claim). The test file gains clean controls plus a planted-violation case for each forbidden fragment, its whitespace-wrapped form, and a nested `SKILL.md`, in each tree, with benign no-CI and quoted exact-fragment controls, and a real-repository green test. The `checkStalePlanPhaseClaims` token in `TargetAssertions` is structural evidence only: it proves the guard's name is present, never that the guard runs or discriminates.

The canonical skill-text footprint is re-measured with the unchanged, read-only instrument `src/test-support/token-accounting.ts`, and the measured final `skillTextLines().total` and `.totalBytes` are transcribed into the strict numeric pins in `src/test-support/token-accounting.test.ts` and the `README.md` measurement cell until all three agree. No pin is deleted or loosened, no figure is projected, and the D15 line/byte semantics are not redefined. The explanatory ledger comment in the test gains the bundle's measured line/byte movement.
